correctness.rationale: On H(d,q) for d≥1,q≥3 the one-particle Fourier energy d(q−1)−q wt(u) gives bosonic total-momentum p and pair-energy t sectors. All symmetric momentum pairs in a nonempty (p,t) sector have a common nonzero coincidence Fourier character; thus exactly one bright vector per sector. Momentum p of weight w=0 permits d+1 even energy indices, and w≥1 permits each integer t in [w,2d], crucially using q≥3. Summation gives bright rank q^(d−1)((d+1)q+d)−d and dark dimension N(N+1)/2 minus that rank, including d=1 boundary. Localized capture follows by Fourier-orthogonal sector projection and root-of-unity sums Σ_{a≠0}|1+ζ^a|²=2(q−2), yielding stated finite rational coefficient sum. Independent numerical full bosonic spectral decompositions at (d,q)=(2,3),(2,4) gave dark ranks 14,82 and exact capture 13/18,1/2 and 11/24,2/9. Empty sectors correctly omitted, rates arbitrary positive. Tests corroborate only finite d,q.
residual_risks: No certification of finite-time rates, inhomogeneous hopping or missing detectors; numerical spectral tests cover small graphs only.
